mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, full_name, phone, address, active, created_at, updated_at FROM users_detail ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users_detail (username, email, full_name, phone, address, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{fullName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{active}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE users_detail SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, full_name = #{fullName}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, active = #{active}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
